reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses diffusion resistance in multi-component high-entropy alloys for Cu–Si systems, not Cr–Zr interdiffusion or Al-doped Cr coatings. E2 examines AlNbTiZr medium-entropy alloy coatings on Zr alloy for corrosion resistance, not Cr coatings or interdiffusion barrier formation. Neither passage provides evidence for a (Cr,Al)2O3 interphase, its barrier mechanism, or performance under the specified conditions.
premises: Al doping in a Cr coating can form a continuous (Cr,Al)2O3 interphase at the coating-substrate interface
This interphase acts as a diffusion barrier by increasing lattice distortion and cohesive energy
The barrier will significantly reduce Cr–Zr interdiffusion at temperatures >700°C
